name: Custom Shape Acrylic Sign Desk Clock With Wooden Base
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic and a wooden LED base, offering a stylish, modern, and functional decorative display.
    - Made with 5mm thick acrylic, providing a sturdy and durable structure with a clean transparent finish.
    - Includes a built-in clockwork mechanism on the back, combining personalized décor with practical time display.
    - Comes with a wooden LED base for stable tabletop placement and an elegant illuminated effect.
    - Designed with USB-powered lighting for convenient everyday use.
    - Available with switch options for:
               +) 7-color multicolor lights
               +) Monochrome lighting
    - Combines custom printing, desk clock function, and soft lighting in one meaningful keepsake piece.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Product size: 7 x 7 in ~ 17.78 x 17.78 cm
    - Clockwork size: 5.5 x 5.5 cm ~ 2.17 x2.17 in
    - Clock hands:
               +) Short hand: 4.4 cm ~ 1.73 in
               +) Long hand: 6.6 cm ~ 2.6 in
               +) Second hand: 7 cm ~ 2.76 in
    - Wooden LED base size:
               +) Length: 15 cm ~ 5.91 in
               +) Width: 5 cm ~ 1.97 in
               +) Slot width: 10 cm ~ 3.94 in
               +) Slot opening: 0.5 cm ~ 0.2 in
               +) Depth: 1.5 cm ~ 0.59 in
               +) Height: 3 cm ~ 1.18 in
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Supports single-sided printing on the acrylic panel and wooden base.

 

  • Lighting & Clock Features:
    - Built with a functional desk clock design and integrated LED display base.
    - Supports:
               +) Monochrome light
               +) Multicolor light
    - The dimmer switch allows:
               +) Press “+” or “−” to adjust brightness
               +) Press the middle button to turn the light on/off
    - 7-color light modes include: Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Cyan, Purple, White
    - Adjustable for fixed single color or colorful gradient mode.
    - The base can memorize the last brightness level and light color used.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a desk clock and a personalized illuminated acrylic sign.
    - Designed for desks, office tables, bedside tables, shelves, classrooms, and home décor spaces.
    - Suitable for teacher gifts, family keepsakes, appreciation gifts, memorial displays, and custom desk decoration.
    - The LED wooden base adds a warm and elegant glow, while the clock function adds everyday practicality.
    - Perfect for combining time display, meaningful customization, and decorative lighting in one product.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for teachers, moms, dads, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Teacher Appreciation Day, birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, graduation gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for desk décor, office gifts, bedside decoration, and personalized keepsake displays.
    - A thoughtful gift for anyone who loves practical décor with a personal touch.
    - Great for home offices, classrooms, study desks, and commemorative gift giving.
    - Adds a warm, stylish, and memorable touch to any space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Acrylic Sign Desk Clock With Wooden Base

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
